pages.title: Basecamp — The 37signals Guide to Internal Communication
pages.description: The how, where, why, and when we communicate. Long form asynchronous? Real-time chat? In-person? Video? Verbal? Written? Via email? In Basecamp? How do we keep everyone in the loop without everyone getting tangled in everyone else’s business? It’s all in here.
headings: Rules of thumb, and general philosophy
Automatic daily: “What did you work on today?”
Automatic weekly: “What will you be working on this week?”

pages.title: Basecamp — Pricing
pages.description: Start free with Basecamp — one project, 20 users, forever free. Or upgrade to Plus (/user/mo) or Pro Unlimited (/mo) for unlimited projects and premium support.
headings: Pick a package and try Basecamp for free.
Top-of-the-line, all-inclusive pricing. Unlimited users, no per-user fees.
A great choice for freelancers, startups, and smaller teams.
The same core features are included with every package.
A stable, well-run company is part of the deal, too.
Risk-free, cancel anytime, no long-term lock-in
A big boost for bootstrappers & small businesses

pages.title: Basecamp — Features, benefits, benefits, and benefits
pages.description: Basecamp continues to get better without getting complicated. For decades we’ve focused on building straightforward project management software that’s exceptionally capable, fast, flexible, reliable, and easy-to-use. This page details some of the key features (and benefits) at the heart of Basecamp.
headings: The Project page keeps it all together
Message Boards for announcements and discussions
To-do Lists for tracking all the little things
Hill Charts show you where things really stand
Card Tables for tracking work through stages
Campfire chats for quick, casual conversations
The Basecamp Calendar for big dates
Docs & Files for reference materials, assets, and links
My Tasks, Events, Today, Bookmarks, and Notes
Everything Views are like having x-ray vision
The Lineup is your bird’s eye view
API, CLI, SDK, Skills, and Integrations
Decide what clients get to see
